title: corylus avellana var. urticifolia
intro: Corylus avellana var. urticifolia, commonly known as Urtica Corylus, is a variant of the hazelnut plant that shares characteristics with stinging nettle. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive function. The therapeutic actions of Urtica Corylus are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, relax muscles, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for a range of ailments. The bioactive constituents of Urtica Corylus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
